tags.instructions: Use this for 1–1000 distinct lead IDs from store metadata; use `enrich-lead` for one lead. It can spend one credit per newly unlocked store contact and two per newly unlocked decision maker, subject to plan exemptions. No outreach is sent. Role fallback defaults to true; disable it for strict matching. Results include only returned leads; unreturned IDs are not declared successful. After an uncertain outcome, inspect account credits/unlocks before resubmitting. Do not split and retry automatically as though processing were atomic.

FunctionInput_store_census_enrichlead.description: Enrich one store lead, optionally unlocking decision-maker contacts.

tags.instructions: Obtain a lead ID from `get-store` or `list-stores` metadata. This can spend credits: one for newly unlocked store contact information and two per newly unlocked decision maker, subject to the account plan. Contacts already unlocked are free to retrieve again. No outreach is sent. Use `batch-enrich-leads` for multiple IDs. Role fallback defaults to true and may return contacts outside your chosen roles; set it false for strict role matching. After an ambiguous failure, inspect credit/account state before retrying.

tags.instructions: Use this for store discovery and prospecting, including CRM and historical criteria. Use `get-store` for a known domain or lead ID. Obtain app IDs from `list-apps`. Omitted platforms means Shopify only. Pass nextCursor as cursor within five minutes with the same filters, sections, sort and limit. Limit is 50–500, default 50. Some filters require Professional or higher; payments and shipping sections are null on lower plans. Contact unlocking is a separate, credit-consuming task in `enrich-lead` or `batch-enrich-leads`.
